items.period: Shuowen seal-style form; modern digital vector uploaded 2023-09-30
items.tradition: Chinese seal-script style, labelled Shuowen seal
items.caption: A modern vector rendering of 請 in Shuowen seal style, showing the traditional graph associated in the Shuowen account with 言 and 青.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of the character 請 in seal-script style.
items.selection_reason: The page identifies the graph, style, Sinica-derived source, direct original file, and CC0 terms. It offers a useful visual reference for the traditional graph while being clearly labelled as a modern redraw, not an excavated artifact.

limitations.text: No ancient artifact photograph or independently dated pre-seal specimen was verified; the selected illustration is a modern vector depiction of a seal-style graph.
The Xiaoxuetang page labels its record 小篆 / 說文‧言部 and its official notice releases queried glyph images under CC0, but the direct image fetch failed, so that candidate is not included.
